answer_sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sl.order_date) AS month,
  SUM(sl.net_amount) AS revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON sl.sale_country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  c.country_name = 'Germany'
  AND sl.channel = 'online'
  AND sl.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-12-31' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', sl.order_date)
ORDER BY
  month
